Name: Lo-Ruhamah
Summary: Lo-Ruhamah (KJV 'Lo-ruhamah'), daughter of Hosea and Gomer, was named by God as a sign: her name means 'not pitied' or 'no mercy,' declaring that God would no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, though He would still have mercy on Judah.
KeyStory: God named Hosea's daughter Lo-Ruhamah — 'not pitied' — as a living sign that His patience with Israel's idolatry had run out.
LifeLesson: Mercy refused long enough becomes judgment pronounced. Lo-Ruhamah's name is a sobering reminder that God's patience, though long, is not endless.
